whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Vrindavan Bhog,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.2★ reviews with 190+ ratings in Bihta, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online orders and table inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, special sweets & chaat menu, aur location directions integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/vrindavanbhog

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Vrindavan Bhog, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Vrindavan Bhog - Sweets Chaat & Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with your sweets & chaat menu, direct WhatsApp ordering, and Bihta location details. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact items aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain."
